data.answer: HairOriginals is a company specializing in premium, ethically sourced human hair extensions and non-surgical hair loss solutions. Founded in 2018 or 2019 by Jitendra Sharma and Piyush Wadhwani, it offers products like clip-in and permanent extensions, scalp toppers, volumizers, and wigs. The company has raised a total of $8.24M over 6 funding rounds, with its latest round being a Series A on February 4, 2025. HairOriginals has 25 institutional investors and 46 angel investors. The company has built an end-to-end, vertically integrated supply chain for human hair in India.

Founded in 2018 (or 2019 per some sources), it offers products like clip-in and permanent extensions, scalp toppers, volumizers, and wigs, serving women and men facing hair thinning or seeking volume, length, and color enhancements via a chemical-free, DIY approach. The company solves accessibility issues in [...] HairOriginals emerged from founder Jitendra Sharma's observations of unethical practices in the hair industry, such as tampered quality and non-transparent sourcing, during his time in beauty. An IIT graduate, Sharma—alongside co-founder Piyush Wadhwani—launched the company in 2018 (or 2019) in Gurugram (Gurgaon), India, rooted in India's temple tradition where women ritually offer hair, aiming to organize the sector ethically and create jobs for the underprivileged.
